item.title: Georgia Power says it can reduce electricity bills despite storm damage repair costs
item.description: Georgia’s main electric power monopoly filed requests with state regulators Tuesday to set new billing rates for customers that will recover the cost of storm-related repairs and adjust for changes in fuel prices. item.title: T.W. Josey High School addresses multiple student altercations
item.description: T.W. Josey High School experienced multiple student altercations this week, prompting school officials to temporarily limit class transitions and increase police presence on campus. item.title: CCBOE Retreat focuses on board roles and collaboration
item.description: The Columbia County Board of Education held a board retreat Thursday at the CCBOE building in Evans to review governance guidelines and clarify the roles and responsibilities of board members. The post CCBOE Retreat focuses on board roles and collaboration appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Doctors Hospital opens revitalized Women’s Diagnostic Center
item.description: Doctors Hospital of Augusta celebrated the addition of its latest care unit, noon Thursday. The Augusta Metro Chamber and Jasmine Sims, chief of staff at Mayor Garnett Johnson’s office, joined hospital staff and administration in cutting the ribbon at the renovated Women’s Diagnostic Center. The post Doctors Hospital opens revitalized Women’s Diagnostic Center appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Mayor Johnson to launch reelection bid at South Augusta food truck event
item.description: Amid a growing field of candidates, Augusta Mayor Garnett L. Johnson announced Thursday he is seeking a second term. The post Mayor Johnson to launch reelection bid at South Augusta food truck event appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Charter rewrite eyes November ballot as committee trims loose ends
